patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a large, high-contrast logotype and overlaid sans-serif text, establishing a premium feel.
Product carousels are presented in a grid-like fashion with subtle borders and award badges, maintaining a clean and organized display.
A clean, modern sans-serif font is used for most headings and body text, complemented by a distinct, elegant logotype for the brand name.
A soft, cool-toned palette of light blues and greys dominates the backgrounds and accents, creating a serene and sophisticated atmosphere.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content to create depth.
The main header transforms from a transparent, larger overlay on the hero to a compact, sticky bar with a solid light blue background upon scrolling.
Editorial-style content blocks feature large, impactful imagery paired with concise text, often alternating layout for visual interest.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a parallax scrolling effect for its background image, where the image moves at a different speed than the foreground content, enhancing visual depth.

The site's main navigation employs a sticky transformation, starting as a transparent, full-width bar over the hero and shrinking into a compact, fixed header with a solid background color as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections likely reveal with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they enter the viewport, suggesting the use of a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll for a smooth, engaging experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant logotype for the brand name, paired with a clean sans-serif for headings (~2-3x body) and body text, with small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (mostly sharp corners, with very slight rounding on product cards and buttons).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around sections and elements, not overly dense or airy).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a prominent, elegant logotype for the brand name, combined with a soft, cool-toned color palette and subtle parallax effects, creates a luxurious and sophisticated feel. This elevates the e-commerce experience beyond a generic template, making the brand feel premium and aspirational.
